Subject: RFP Question — billing mechanics and invoice adjustments

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the draft commercial terms in the RFP response. Two quick clarifications from procurement/finance so we can compare apples-to-apples across suppliers:

1) Metering unit — do you bill per token generated, or do you use a per-1000-token unit with rounding? How is prompt vs. completion token split handled for pricing?
2) Onboarding credits / promotional discounts — we need a clear amortization schedule over invoices; can credits be applied pro-rata across the first N invoices?
3) Overage settlement — would Redwood offset overages with future credits or issue refunds? What is the reconciliation window?

If you can provide a worked example (month with spike, then lower usage) that shows how the invoice would land, that would be great.

Appreciate it — we are trying to finalize supplier short-list this week.

Regards,

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Troy Han <troy.han@zenpharm.com>

Subject: Re: RFP Question — billing mechanics and invoice adjustments

Hi Troy / Aria,

Thanks — great questions. Below is a concise explanation plus a short worked example. I attached a pricing appendix (redwood_pricing_appendix_zenpharm.xlsx) with the full table and per-region parity notes.

Summary of commercial mechanics:
- Unit definition: Redwood invoices on a per-1,000-token unit (we display per-token for UI clarity). We round up to the nearest 1,000-token unit per request on the invoice level to simplify metering disputes (example: 1,250 tokens => 2 units). Prompt vs completion tokens are metered separately and summed on the invoice; pricing tiers apply to the combined token units.
- Commit ladder: We offer a monthly committed token band with step discounts applied to usage up to the committed band. Usage beyond committed units is billed at the published overage band rate, but eligible for credits per our smoothing program (see below).
- Onboarding credits: Any promotional credit can be amortized across the first 3 invoicing cycles by default (customer may request 6 cycles for large deals; we can accommodate with finance approval). Credits apply as invoice line-item reductions, not as retro refunds.
- Overage settlement & reconciliation: Standard is a monthly invoice with a 30-day reconciliation window. If actual monthly usage materially exceeds forecasts and triggers a contract true-up, adjustments are made on the subsequent invoice as a positive or negative line item. For documented disputes we retain a 45-day formal dispute window.
- Credits vs refunds: We issue account credits that offset future invoices. Refunds are only considered for genuine billing errors >$5k and require Finance sign-off.

Worked example (illustrative):
- Committed band: 200M tokens / month at $0.45 per 1k-token unit (committed band price).
- Published overage rate: $0.70 per 1k-token unit.
- Usage month 1: 260M tokens (40M over) => billed as:
  - 200M @ $0.45/1k = (200,000 * $0.45) = $90,000
  - 40M over @ $0.70/1k = (40,000 * $0.70) = $28,000
  - Gross invoice = $118,000
- Onboarding credit: $30,000 amortized over first 3 invoices => $10,000 credit applied Month 1 invoice => Net = $108,000
- Month 2 usage: 150M tokens => 150M @ tiered pricing (falls below committed band) => we still honor committed band discounts for the month; invoice shows $67,500 gross. Amortized credit Month 2 = $10,000 => Net Month 2 = $57,500.
- Reconciliation: If cumulative usage for quarter warrants a true-up (contracted annual minimum clause), we adjust on next invoice. Any overage credits from our smoothing program are shown as separate credit lines.

Smoothing / crediting program (optional):
- If ZenPharm opts into our smoothing program, 50% of overage dollars in a spike month can be converted into a credit ladder that vests over the following two months (25% month+1, 25% month+2), helping belt-and-braces short-term spikes. This is not automatic — it is an elected program we include in the SOW.

Regional parity note: Our standard list prices are shown in USD. For EU regions we apply a 5% uplift due to localized infra and compliance costs, which is reflected in the appendix.

Next steps: I attached the priced appendix and a short multiparty map. If this structure looks acceptable, Marissa and I will prepare the commercial exhibit and an amortization schedule to append to the SOW (DocuSign link included).

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Commercial Sales, Redwood Inference

Subject: Fwd: RFP: Metering, Invoicing & Amortized Discounting — commercial proposal for ZenPharm

Rishi — quick internal note before we send the commercial exhibit to Troy.

A few negotiation levers we can offer without legal rework:
- Increase onboarding credit to $45k but extend amortization to 6 months (softens near-term cash impact).
- Offer smoothing program enrollment on first 6 months with a one-time admin fee ($5k) to cover reporting.
- If ZenPharm signs a 12-month committed monthly token band at >=200M, approve a progressive discount: 5% for months 1-3, 7% for months 4-6, 10% thereafter (this is a play to encourage stickiness).

Also note: finance prefers credits applied as invoice offsets (not external refunds) — keeps bookkeeping simple for both parties.

If Rishi is comfortable, give the green light to include the 6-month amortization option and a conditional 10% tail discount in the exhibit. Priya, please confirm the SOW language we would use to ensure credits are non-transferable and expire after 12 months if unused.

Marissa
VP, Commercial Strategy

Troy / Aria — following up with a consolidated answer and an optional concession we can include in the commercial exhibit: 

1) Metering & rounding: per-1k-token units, prompt + completion summed, invoice rounding to nearest 1k per-request aggregated monthly.
2) Credits amortization: default 3-month amortization; optional 6-month amortization for onboarding credits up to $50k (we propose $45k for ZenPharm on sign).
3) Overage settlement: monthly invoices with 30-day reconciliation; overages are billed on the invoice and can be partially converted into credits via the smoothing program (50% convertable into a 2-month vesting credit ladder). Refunds only for confirmed billing mistakes >$5k.
4) Example invoice: see attached appendix (redwood_pricing_appendix_zenpharm.xlsx).
5) Additional concession (optional): if ZenPharm signs a 12-month commitment >=200M tokens/month, we will add a step-discount schedule in the exhibit (5% months 1-3, 7% months 4-6, 10% months 7-12).

Attachments: redwood_pricing_appendix_zenpharm.xlsx (pricing bands and sample invoices), zenpharm_multiparty_map.pdf. DocuSign link for the commercial exhibit: https://docusign.example/sign/abc123 (placeholder).
